summary: First-run frontend E2E for DCS QBank. Verified dashboard tiles & semesters, mode dialog (incl. empty-subject disabled states), study mode (options lock, verdict/explanation panel, side-panel placeholder, image zoom, keyboard 1-4 & arrows), wrong-answer bank (nav badge, items, filter + practice route), exam setup (toggles, time select, summary), exam runner (timer countdown, answer locking, flag, answered-count, resume via sessionStorage + resume-exam-banner on dashboard after reload), exam results (score, result tiles, filters, review items with explanation), dashboard DataTools (export/import/reset dialogs). No JS errors in console.

issues: Route is not declared in App.js but accidentally works because it is caught by /subject/:sid/study/:cid with cid='wrong'. Works today but is fragile and relies on StudySession's special handling. Consider declaring explicit route.

action_items: Nothing critical. Optional: declare an explicit route '/subject/:sid/study/wrong' in App.js for clarity; it currently matches the generic :cid param.

practice-wrong-btn is only rendered when a specific subject filter is selected AND wrong.length > 0 (per WrongAnswers.jsx L74). This matches the test spec which says 'subject filter, practice-wrong-btn' but is worth confirming is the intended UX (no 'practice all wrong' when filter = all).
critical_code_review_comments: progress.js emptyState spread when reading can leak stale defaults into existing state after schema changes; acceptable for v1.
exam.js pickQuestions includeWrong may exceed requested count when wrong > count (picked array can be longer than count). Minor edge-case.
/subject/:sid/study/wrong relies on cid param wildcard; add explicit route for maintainability.
DataTools uses Blob/URL.createObjectURL in exportProgress — correct; no cleanup issues observed.
seed_data_creation: none; used in-browser localStorage/sessionStorage during tests then cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is at https://cardiac-sono-quiz.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend is template-only (not used). All UI data-testids referenced by the spec exist and work. Keyboard shortcuts in StudySession: digits 1-4 select option, ArrowLeft/Right navigate. Exam state is saved to sessionStorage key dcs_exam_active and survives reload. Progress localStorage key is dcs_qbank_progress_v1. Note: /subject/:sid/study/wrong is handled by StudySession via generic :cid match.
